d: Sharabbandi vale bihar men sharab taskaron ke khilaph mady nishedh vibhag ne ek bar phir bari karravaee ki hai. rajdhani patna men gupt suchna ke aadhar par chhapemari karte hue tim ne ek KIA Seltos gari ki dikki se videshi sharab ki bari khep baramad ki hai aur mauke se 2 taskaron ko giraphtar kiya hai.
